scope.zh: 首次勘测到有非智慧生命的行星。
scope.en: The first survey of a world with non-sapient life.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到和[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]完全不一样的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[from.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[from.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星生命！这是我们第一次遇到和自己完全不一样的生命形态。

这一发现终于使我们相信，[root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]这颗行星，在宇宙中并不孤独。尽管这些[from.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到……
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [from.GetName]: the [from.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien life! For the first time, we have encountered lifeforms which originated outside our self.

This discovery finally confirms that we, the planet [root.owner.capital_scope.GetName], are not alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [from.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that are...

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上有了意外发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]上充满了外星生命。这是我们有史以来第一次遭遇源自[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]以外的有机生命。

尽管[From.GetName]上发现的外星生物都没有智慧，最新校正过的预测显示星系中存在智慧有机体的可能性非常高。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an unanticipated discovery on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien lifeforms. For the first time in history, we have encountered organic life that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, newly recalibrated prognoses suggest a high probability of intelligent organics in the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们一直都在为这一天作准备。[Root.GetName]确认了外星有机体存在于[From.GetName]之上。尽管遭遇的生命体都没有较高的认知能力，我们无法排除星系中极有可能充满了智慧有机体的可能性。
texts.en: We have been preparing for this day. The [Root.GetName] has confirmed the existence of alien organics on [From.GetName]. Though none of the encountered lifeforms possess higher reasoning functions, we cannot preclude the now heightened probability of a galaxy infested with sapient organics.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]有了史无前例的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]上充满了外星有机体！尽管这些生命体似乎都没有自我意识来感激[Root.Owner.GetAdj]照料，但遭遇到更高级智慧也只是时间问题！
texts.en: A historic discovery has been made by the [Root.GetName] on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with alien organics! Though none of the new lifeforms appear to possess the self-awareness required to appreciate [Root.Owner.GetAdj] pampering, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter beings that do!

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]报告在[From.GetName]上有了重大发现：发现了大量外星有机生命！尽管它们的进化程度都不足以成为合适的同化对象，在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外遭遇智慧有机体的可能性现在已大大增加。
texts.en: The [Root.GetName] reports a momentous find on [From.GetName]: myriad alien organic lifeforms have been discovered! While none of them has evolved to a stage we would consider desirable for assimilation, the likelihood of encountering sapient organics beyond [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] is now more promising than ever.

texts.zh:
一位[Root.Owner.GetScientist]说，“快来看看这个小家伙！”

有外星生命，就在[From.GetName]！这些野东西可能不会那么快能和我们说话，但至少我们知道在宇宙的航行中不是孤单的了！

可能我们最后会发现这个星系到处都是各种不同的生命。
texts.en:
In the words of one [Root.Owner.GetScientist], "Get a load of this little guy!"

Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.

texts.zh:
我们兴奋得发抖。

有外星生命，就在[From.GetName]！这些野东西可能不会那么快能和我们说话，但至少我们知道在宇宙的航行中不是孤单的了！

可能我们最后会发现这个星系到处都是各种不同的生命。
texts.en:
We vibrate with excitement.

Alien life, right here on [From.GetName]! These wild things will not be talking to us any time soon, but at least we know we are not alone on the cosmic journey.

The galaxy just may turn out to be rife with lifeforms after all.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]上获得了惊人的发现——[From.GetPlanetMoon]充满了外星有机生命！这是历史上第一次，我们遇到了起源于[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]以外的生命形态。

这一惊人发现使得相信“我们在宇宙中孤苦伶仃”的人闭上了嘴。尽管这些[From.GetName]上的外星生命似乎并无高等智慧，但很可能用不了多久我们就会遇到智慧物种，不管是有机体还是机械体。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made a startling find on [From.GetName] - the [From.GetPlanetMoon] is teeming with organic alien creatures. For the first time in history, we have encountered life forms that did not originate on [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName].

This amazing discovery has silenced those who believed we were alone in the universe. Although none of the alien creatures found on [From.GetName] are sapient, it is likely only a matter of time before we encounter sentient beings, biological or mechanical.

texts.zh: 生命。耀眼地演化的生命触手可及，我们随时可以从中采集样本促进自身的发展。自古以来我们就收集了[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上所有的有趣样本，但却从来不敢设想在刚踏出征程的第一步就可以寻得更多的独特基因。
texts.en: Life. Glorious evolved life is out there and ready to be sampled for our progress. We have long since gathered all interesting samples on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] and didn't dare hope that we would have access to further genetic uniqueness so soon after leaving home.

label.en: We may not be alone out here.

label.zh: 我们会准备好面对他们。
label.en: We will be ready for them.

label.zh: 完美。准备初步的互娱协议。

# 发现外星生命 / The Discovery of Alien Life

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories

## 如何开始 How it starts

on_survey_planet（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1139）触发 progress.2（progress_events.txt:57）。

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

按帝国类型（普通、荒野、机械、灭绝/仆从/同化机械、风暴追逐者）七种措辞的单页；确认后30天触发 story.3（有危险野兽阻碍）或 story.1。

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 选项只是措辞不同。
